msg: Hello, we are a Dutch family of four staying at a hotel in Cartagena. I am Advanced and would like to do a night dive too, my wife prefers snorkeling, our son is 13 and would like to get certified, and our daughter is 5. What can each of us do, and how much would it be?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

The Rosario Islands are a lovely place for both diving and snorkeling. Since you’re staying in Cartagena, these are the options that fit:

You’ll need to stay overnight on the islands; accommodation isn’t included. It requires a diving certification. It includes two guided snorkeling sessions, equipment, lunch, and round-trip boat transport. It takes two days, certifies him to dive to 18 m, and requires at least one night on the islands; accommodation isn’t included. - **Your 5-year-old daughter:** The minimum age for snorkeling is 6, and for Bubble Makers it’s 8, so those activities aren’t available for her yet.

Online prices include the 10% website-booking discount. The 3-dive package is arranged through a team advisor; the other two options can be booked online:

- [PADI Open Water course](https://book.divingplanet.org/book/basic-course/4?language=en)
- [Snorkeling Tour](https://book.divingplanet.org/book/superficio/3?language=en)

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 287 USD · 319 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD
• Snorkeling Tour: 126 USD · 140 USD
• PADI Basic Course (Open Water): 693 USD · 770 USD

Would you like help connecting with a team advisor about the night-dive package?

msg: Thanks. What exactly is the night-dive package and does it include lunch? Can my wife come on the same boat? And is there anything at all for our 5-year-old?
reply:
The **3-dive package** includes two daytime dives and one night dive in one day. It’s for certified divers with at least Open Water certification. Departing from Cartagena, it includes round-trip boat transport and lunch. You’ll need to stay overnight on the islands; accommodation isn’t included. The online price is **287 USD per person** (regular price: **319 USD**).

Your wife can join the boat with the **companion plan** if she doesn’t dive or snorkel. It includes the boat, lunch, insurance, and the National Natural Park entrance fee. The online price is **80 USD** (regular price: **89 USD**). If she wants to snorkel instead, snorkeling is available from age 6. Snorkeling and diving happen in different areas; whether everyone travels on the same boat depends on the group size.

Your 5-year-old can ride along on the boat for free, but can’t join the in-water activities yet; snorkeling starts at age 6.

So I can recommend what suits the one who hasn't chosen yet: will you be here for *one day* or *several days*? 🌊

msg: Our daughter just rides along, she's 5. So: me the night-dive package, my wife snorkeling, our son the Open Water course. How do we book?
reply:
Perfect! Your 5-year-old can ride along with you and enjoy the boat trip and islands, though she can’t join the in-water activities yet.

You can book the snorkeling tour and Open Water course online using their links. The 10% online discount is applied automatically. Your son is 13, so he meets the minimum age for the Open Water course; minors must be accompanied by a responsible adult. International guests pay by card online. For your certified dives, bring your certification card or show it on the day.

The night-dive package is arranged through a team advisor, so would you like me to connect you with one for that booking?

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.
